body.voice_description: Create an original chess-coach voice for an illustrated character. Character: Restrained observer from Havana who notices exactly what changed. Voice direction: Low, calm female alto with a light Cuban accent. Precise, restrained phrasing, almost deadpan, with a small warmth at the end. Fluent spoken English, with the requested accent. Normal conversational pace with clear teaching emphasis; aim for an eight-to-ten-second passage without long dramatic pauses. Clean, dry studio recording, one intelligible voice, no music, background noise or animal sounds. Finish the final word completely with a natural settled ending. An original character voice, not an imitation of a named person or existing character.
body.text: One thing changed. The defender moved, and the piece it guarded is now alone. The other side can take it. Look at that square again.

encoding.method: SoundFile float64 decode; arithmetic channel mean; band-limited FFT resample to 48000 Hz; libsndfile Ogg Opus at compression level 0.93
